items.label: spent fuel
items.quote: High-level waste is primarily spent fuel removed from reactors after producing electricity.

items.label: fission products
items.quote: These isotopes, called "fission products," account for most of the heat and penetrating radiation in high-level waste.

items.label: Transuranic wastes
items.quote: Transuranic wastes, sometimes called TRU, account for most of the radioactive hazard remaining in high-level waste after 1,000 years.

items.label: cesium-137
items.quote: The fission creates radioactive isotopes of lighter elements such as cesium-137 and strontium-90.

items.label: protective shoe covers
items.quote: This waste typically consists of contaminated protective shoe covers and clothing, wiping rags, mops, filters

items.label: medical tubes
items.quote: reactor water treatment residues, equipment and tools, luminous dials, medical tubes, swabs, injection needles, syringes, and laboratory animal carcasses and tissues.
